'''Ada Lell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for [[Lant Mining Corporation]] as mid-level manager and troubleshooter for problematic departments. Lell was also an operative for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], and passed on whatever information she could glean about LMC operations.
